# Focal ar Fhocal: Lexicography projects in Foras na Gaeilge

The New English-Irish Dictionary is online since 2013 and the print version of it _(Concise English-Irish Dictionary)_ is available since 2020.

In this information session, we will discuss the progress in our lexicography projects in the last year and discuss our plans for the year ahead. Among the projects that will be discussed are foclóir.ie, teanglann.ie, the print dictionary, the Grammar Wizard and new dictionaries that are scheduled to begin next year. A Q&A session will follow the presentation.

Note: this session will be in Irish only.

- **Date:** Friday, 29 October 2021
- **Time:** 13:30-15:00
- **Link:** **[Zoom »](https://us06web.zoom.us/j/89225107161)**
